def: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training: OpenAI's 2021 image and text encoders, trained contrastively on 400 million web image-caption pairs so matching images and captions land close together in one space.
practice: Its image tower became a common vision encoder for VLMs, its text tower conditions diffusion models such as Stable Diffusion, and its similarity powers zero-shot classification, image search and CLIP score.
